personality_one_liner: A refined, cinematic dark grimoire that feels like wielding ancient magic through a modern, glass-layered interface.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for cinematic feel; cards should never sit flush to screen edges; use minimum md margin.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Welcome the player and provide quick access to search, popular spells, or recent filters.

states.empty: Illustration of a closed grimoire with 'Inizia la tua ricerca magica.'
states.error: Message 'Connessione persa' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Cinematic hero area at the top with a dark atmospheric background image, overlaid with a subtle glass search bar. Below, horizontal scrollable sections for 'Scuole di Magia' (Schools of Magic) using tinted glass cards, and a 'Incantesimi in Evidenza' (Featured Spells) vertical list. The hero area should use the dragon d20 logo as a subtle watermark or primary element.

screens.name: SpellsList
screens.purpose: Browse and filter the complete spell dictionary in real-time.

states.empty: Icon of an empty scroll with 'Nessun incantesimo trovato.'
states.error: Error fetching spell list, retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header containing the real-time search input and a horizontally scrolling row of pill-shaped filter chips (Livello, Scuola, Classe). The list below uses simple but elegant list items with the spell name in Serif, level/school in small Sans, and an interactive 'Favorite' star icon on the right edge. List items have a subtle divider.

screens.name: SpellDetail
screens.purpose: Immersive, easy-to-read reference for a specific spell's mechanics and lore.
screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image of a glowing magic book at the top with a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim (top to bottom). The spell name (large Serif, 2xl+) sits at the bottom of the scrim. Below the hero, a tactical grid of core metadata (Tempo di lancio, Gittata, Componenti, Durata) using brandTertiary tinted containers. The description text follows with generous line height and editorial spacing. A sticky Floating Action Button (FAB) at the bottom right allows adding/removing from Favorites.

screens.name: Favorites
screens.purpose: Quick access to locally saved spells for fast reference during a tabletop session.

states.empty: Icon of an unlit candle with 'Il tuo grimorio è vuoto. Aggiungi i tuoi incantesimi preferiti.'

screens.layout: Simple, focused list layout similar to SpellsList but without the complex filter chips. Just a search bar in a glass header and the list of saved spells, prioritized for fast reading in-game.

dragon_d20_logo.alt: Polyhedral d20 dice resting in shadow

magic_book_hero.alt: Glowing magical spellbook with colorful smoke

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a strict Glass/Luxe Dark personality. Avoid pure black backgrounds with extreme white contrast; use the provided #0A0A0B and #F0EBE1.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' (or another elegant Serif) for display headings and spell titles, and 'Satoshi' for body text and metadata.
For the SpellDetail screen, ensure the full-bleed hero image has a strict gradient-to-dark scrim (transparent to #0A0A0B) so the overlaid spell title is perfectly readable.
Avoid any generic 'parchment' backgrounds or skeuomorphic beige textures. The aesthetic is modern, dark, and cinematic with gold (#D4AF37) accents.
Do not use blue, purple, or indigo anywhere. Stick to the midnight/charcoal base with gold/amber accents.

Implement real-time filtering in the SpellsList screen. Based on user feedback for D&D Beyond, users want fast access to spell details, so ensure navigating from the list to the detail screen is instant.
Make the 'Favorite' FAB sticky at the bottom right of the SpellDetail screen.
